group: General AI assistants and research tools
category_overview: These six are horizontal assistants rather than departmental systems. Gemini, Claude and ChatGPT Enterprise compete head-on as general chat-plus-agent platforms, while NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) and Perplexity specialise in grounded research: the former over documents you upload, the latter over the live web with citations. Overlap is growing fast: all three big assistants now offer deep research, file creation, connectors and agents; Perplexity resells GPT, Gemini and Claude models inside its own interface; and Google's Gemini Enterprise routes work to Claude as well as Gemini. Enterprises usually standardise on the assistant bundled with their productivity suite (Gemini for Google Workspace shops, Microsoft 365 Copilot elsewhere), add one frontier chat platform (ChatGPT Enterprise or Claude Enterprise) for knowledge workers, and buy Perplexity Enterprise or Gemini Notebook as a niche research tool for strategy, market-intelligence and L&D teams. The decisive procurement differences are training defaults (every enterprise tier excludes training; the consumer tiers of Gemini, Claude and Perplexity do not), compliance coverage (FedRAMP/HIPAA vary by tier and even by sub-feature) and pricing model (flat seats versus seat-plus-usage).

tools.name: Gemini
tools.vendor: Google (Alphabet). Family: Gemini app (Google AI Plus/Pro/Ultra), Gemini in Google Workspace, Gemini Enterprise (Google Cloud; Business/Standard/Plus editions) and the new Gemini agent. Brief's guess correct.
tools.what_it_is: Google's general AI assistant. Surfaces: the Gemini web/mobile app; the side panel in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Chat, Drive and Vids; Chrome; and the Gemini Enterprise app on Google Cloud with connectors to non-Google systems.
key_capabilities: Deep Research, Canvas, Gems, Gemini Live, image/video generation
Drafting and summarisation in Gmail/Docs; Sheets dashboards with HubSpot/Salesforce imports; Meet 'Take notes for me'
Workspace Studio skills that turn SOPs into agentic workflows
Gemini Enterprise: permission-aware search over 100+ connectors, no-code agents, multi-model routing including Claude
Bundled Gemini Notebook (ex-NotebookLM) for source-grounded research
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Workspace Business/Enterprise/Education: no training or human review without permission; admin-set retention (Gemini in apps 90 days to indefinite, Gemini app default 18 months); DLP applies; SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701/42001, FedRAMP High, HIPAA BAA, but Google states Gemini Notebook and Gemini in Chrome are not yet covered. Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus add data residency, CMEK (US/EU), VPC-SC and Access Transparency with HIPAA/FedRAMP/ISO/SOC/PCI DSS/BSI C5; the Business edition lacks these controls. Consumer plans sit under consumer terms.
tools.licensing_pricing: Bundled: Workspace Business Standard US$14/user/month (annual) includes Gemini in apps and Gemini Notebook; Business Starter is Gmail-only; Enterprise 'contact sales' (pricing page geo-localises, showing INR in India). Gemini Enterprise: Business from US$21/seat/month (seat-capped), Standard/Plus from US$30; independent trackers cite $21/$30/$50 annual or $25/$35/$60 monthly plus pay-as-you-go overages (Claude models overage-only). Consumer: AI Plus $4.99, Pro $19.99, Ultra $99.99–199.99/month.
tools.integrations: Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Chat, Drive, Vids, Chrome auto-browse; Workspace MCP server (preview); Gemini Enterprise connectors to Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Notion, GitHub/GitLab, DocuSign, BigQuery.
tools.recent_developments: Apr 2026 Cloud Next: Workspace Intelligence, Studio skills, MCP server, US/EU sovereign controls. 16 Jul 2026: NotebookLM renamed Gemini Notebook. Aug 2026: Gemini Enterprise pay-as-you-go edition. 8 Oct 2026 (Gemini at Work): a single 'Gemini agent' plus coworker agents with their own Workspace identity, Claude selectable, included at no extra charge for Gemini Enterprise and Workspace Business/Enterprise (private preview). Gemini 4 Argon is the current frontier model.
tools.best_fit_departments: Strongest where Workspace is the system of record: Core 01, 04, 11, 13, 18, 28, 29, 31, 33, 39, 54 and analytics-heavy 16, 20, 50 via Sheets/Data Insights. Specialist fits (06–08, 23, 47–49, 51, 53) are weak: a general assistant without domain tooling; 47, 49 and 51 belong with Gemini in Security, Code Assist or Vertex AI.
tools.training_notes: Master @-mentioning Drive files, Gems, Deep Research, Studio skills and citation checking, and understand how sharing permissions and DLP bound what Gemini can see; admins must choose edition and set retention. Core 6–8 h; Advanced 12–16 h; Specialist 20–30 h.
tools.caveats: Three overlapping products under one brand with different terms; features vary by edition and region; Notebook/Chrome compliance gap; Gemini Enterprise Business lacks enterprise compliance; personal Google accounts fall under consumer terms; Gemini agent still in preview; outputs need verification.

tools.name: Claude
tools.vendor: Anthropic PBC. Family: Claude Free/Pro/Max, Claude Team and Enterprise (marketed together as 'Claude for Work'), Claude Code, Cowork, Design, and the Claude Developer Platform (API). Brief's guess correct.
tools.what_it_is: General AI assistant and agent platform. Surfaces: web, macOS/Windows desktop, iOS/Android, Chrome extension, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace; an Enterprise seat bundles Chat, Claude Code, Cowork and Design. The same models are sold via API and cloud marketplaces.
key_capabilities: Projects with shared instructions and files; memory across conversations
Artifacts plus finished Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with tracked changes
MCP connectors (Salesforce, Gmail, Slack, Drive, BigQuery, Microsoft 365) and custom connectors
Web search/research, skills and department plugins distributed through an enterprise marketplace
Claude Code for engineering; browser and computer use (beta)
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Team/Enterprise/API: not used for training by default (feedback opt-in only; Owners can disable feedback). Consumer Free/Pro/Max: governed by a user-controlled 'Model Improvement' setting. Enterprise adds SSO, domain capture, SCIM, RBAC, audit logs, custom retention, CMEK, IP allowlisting, Compliance API, OpenTelemetry and a HIPAA-ready BAA. Commercial certifications: SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001:2023; trust centre also lists CSA STAR and FedRAMP High/DoD IL4-5 for government deployments. Team lacks HIPAA.
tools.licensing_pricing: USD: Free $0; Pro $20/month or $17/month annual; Max $100 or $200/month. Team Standard seat $25 monthly or $20 annual (2-seat minimum), Premium seat $125/$100. Enterprise $20/seat/month on annual billing plus usage billed at API rates, 20-seat minimum. Not bundled with any suite.
tools.integrations: Slack, Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), Google Workspace, Chrome, Salesforce, BigQuery, GitHub, Figma, Canva, DocuSign; custom MCP servers; API via Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud (Anthropic-managed since 22 Oct 2026) and Microsoft Foundry.
tools.recent_developments: Feb 2026: department plugins and enterprise plugin marketplace. 2026 models: Opus 4.6–4.8, Fable 5 (Jun), Sonnet 5, Opus 5 (Jul), Fable 5.1 (Sep), Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 (Sep–Oct); Sonnet 4.5 retires 30 Nov 2026. Code with Claude 2026: multi-agent orchestration, Outcomes, Claude Finance, Add-ins. Oct 2026: inference hooks GA, Claude Security beta for Enterprise. Run-rate revenue passed $30B in Apr 2026.
tools.best_fit_departments: Strong for long-document analysis and drafting: 02, 03, 05–08, 20, 21, 27, 39, 53 (Advanced/Specialist) plus Core 01, 04, 11, 13, 31, 33, 34. Weak: 37 Customer Support and 45 IT (no native ticketing/ITSM), 46 ERP, 47 Cyber Ops (no SIEM integration) and 60 Supply Chain, where it is a drafting aid only.
tools.training_notes: Prompting with Projects, connector scopes, verifying citations and numbers, artifact/file workflows and skills; admins learn RBAC, retention and the Compliance API; technical roles add Claude Code and agents. Core 6–10 h; Advanced 12–18 h; Specialist 24–40 h.
tools.caveats: Usage is billed at API rates on top of Enterprise seats; 20-seat annual minimum; consumer training defaults differ, so block personal accounts; HIPAA only via Enterprise/API BAA configuration; Fable 5/5.1 require 30-day API retention; frequent model deprecations; Trust Centre documents are gated.

tools.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
tools.vendor: OpenAI. Family: ChatGPT Free/Go/Plus/Pro (consumer), ChatGPT Business (self-serve teams), ChatGPT Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare; Codex; API platform. Brief's guess correct.
tools.what_it_is: OpenAI's managed ChatGPT plan for organisations: the ChatGPT web, desktop and mobile apps plus an admin console. Standard seats include ChatGPT, GPTs, Projects, Apps, Company Knowledge, ChatGPT Agent/Work, Deep Research and Codex; Codex-only seats are also sold.
key_capabilities: Company Knowledge: answers grounded in connected SharePoint, Teams, Slack and Drive content
Workspace agents with scheduling and Slack delivery; shared team tasks
ChatGPT Work: multi-step actions that produce spreadsheets, slides, docs and web apps
Deep Research, data analysis, Canvas, memory, custom GPTs
Codex coding agent with computer use and record/replay
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Enterprise/Business/Edu/API: no training by default (feedback opt-in). Enterprise: admin-set retention (deleted chats purged within 30 days), AES-256/TLS 1.2+, SAML SSO, SCIM (tenant-wide since Aug 2026), Compliance API, audit logs, Enterprise Key Management; data residency for new Enterprise/Edu workspaces in US, Europe, UK, Japan, Canada, South Korea, Singapore, Australia, India and UAE; inference residency in US, Europe and UAE. Certifications: SOC 2 Type 2 (Enterprise, Business, Edu, API), ISO 27001/27701 (API, Enterprise, Edu), ISO 42001, CSA STAR Level 1; HIPAA BAA for qualifying use; Business has no BAA.
tools.licensing_pricing: Enterprise: unpublished, contact sales, annual, billed via credits or tokens; independent 2026 trackers report about US$60/user/month (range $45–75) with roughly 150-seat minimums. Business: Standard $25/user/month or $20 annual, Premium $125 or $100 annual (5x usage, no five-hour cap), from 2 users, seats mixable. Not bundled with any suite.
tools.integrations: Microsoft SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive sync; Slack (read and actions); Google Drive/Gmail; GitHub via Codex; plugins and apps; Frontier agent platform for building agents over enterprise software.
tools.recent_developments: 5 May 2026: GPT-5.5 Instant becomes default. 22 May: workspace agents GA. Aug 2026: Premium seats. 29 Sep: GPT-6.1 Sol in Work/Codex. 7 Oct: GPT-6 rollout. Oct 2026: sites data residency, locked chats, workspace analytics. Feb 2026: Frontier enterprise agent platform. Rename flag: the former Team tier is now sold as ChatGPT Business; verify naming in contracts.
tools.best_fit_departments: Core 01, 11, 13, 17, 31, 33, 34, 39, 50 and Advanced 02, 20, 27, 35, 38, 40, 52, 57, 58 fit well; 41/42 via Codex. Weaker: 03 M&A and 22 Treasury (no deal-room or treasury connectors, high confidentiality) and 53/59, where it is a drafting aid only.
tools.training_notes: Model and reasoning-level picker, Projects and connector permissions, agent-mode risks and approvals, verifying outputs, data-residency awareness, governance of GPT publishing. Core 6–10 h; Advanced 12–18 h; Specialist 20–30 h.
tools.caveats: Enterprise price is negotiated and credit/token billing is complex; residency applies only to new workspaces with feature limits in the UAE; agents act on your systems and need governance; consumer ChatGPT has different defaults; openai.com and help pages were read via a reader proxy because direct fetches are blocked.

tools.name: NotebookLM
tools.vendor: Google. Rename flag: NotebookLM became Gemini Notebook on 16 Jul 2026, and NotebookLM Enterprise became Gemini Notebook Enterprise (Google Cloud, sold within Gemini Enterprise). Brief's vendor guess correct; the handbook name is outdated.
tools.what_it_is: Source-grounded research and writing tool: users upload documents, Google Docs/Slides and URLs (Enterprise adds Word, PowerPoint and Excel) and receive cited answers plus generated briefing and study artefacts. Web app at notebook.google.com with mobile apps; the Enterprise edition runs inside a Google Cloud project.
key_capabilities: Cited Q&A strictly over uploaded sources, with reasoning steps shown
Audio and Video Overviews, mind maps, reports, flashcards, quizzes, data tables, slide decks
Source suggestions via Google Search when building a knowledge base
Exports to PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, PPTX, JSON and images
Limits: free 100 notebooks/50 sources; Pro 500/300; Enterprise 500/300, 500 MB per source, 500 queries per day
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Consumer: content not used to train foundation models unless feedback is given (feedback de-linked and kept up to 3 years). Workspace/Education: never human-reviewed or used for training even with feedback; Google notes Gemini Notebook is not yet covered by Workspace SOC/ISO/FedRAMP/HIPAA attestations. Gemini Notebook Enterprise: data stays in your Cloud project (US/EU multi-region), IAM roles, CMEK, VPC-SC, Access Transparency, project-only sharing; supports HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701, SOC 1/2/3, PCI DSS and BSI C5.
tools.licensing_pricing: Free with a Google account; higher limits via Google AI Plus $4.99, Pro $19.99 and Ultra $99.99–199.99/month. Bundled as 'Gemini Notebook' in Workspace Business Standard (US$14/user/month annual) and above. Enterprise edition via Gemini Enterprise seats (Business from US$21, Standard/Plus from US$30/seat/month) or standalone pay-as-you-go; no list price published, contact sales.
tools.integrations: Google Drive, Docs and Slides, web URLs, Microsoft Office files (Enterprise), the Gemini app and Gemini Enterprise as a data source, exports to Office formats.
tools.recent_developments: 8 Jun 2026: Gemini 3.5 default, Search-based source suggestions, reasoning display and rich exports. 16 Jul 2026: rename to Gemini Notebook for consumer and Enterprise editions, with automatic redirects. 1 Aug 2026: Gemini Enterprise pay-as-you-go edition. 14 Sep 2026: CMEK key rotation GA. 22 Oct 2026: single-user quota caps for admins.
tools.best_fit_departments: 13 L&D (Core) is the standout: quizzes, flashcards and audio/video explainers from course material. 33 Market Research, 04 Board Secretariat and 39 Product Management fit well for pack and document search. Specialist 03, 06 and 07 fit only on Gemini Notebook Enterprise; the consumer/Workspace edition lacks the attestations regulated work requires.
tools.training_notes: Curating and trusting sources, reading citations, notebook sharing scopes, choosing the right edition, reviewing Audio/Video Overviews for oversimplification; it is not a calculator. Core 6–8 h; Specialist 20 h including governance set-up.
tools.caveats: Rename leaves mixed documentation; compliance gap outside the Enterprise edition; per-notebook source and daily query limits; Excel sheets capped near 150k cells; watermarks mandatory in India, Korea and Vietnam; Enterprise pricing unpublished; answers are only as good as uploaded sources.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.vendor: Perplexity AI, Inc. Family: Perplexity Free/Pro/Max, Comet browser, Perplexity Computer agent, Sonar API. Brief's guess correct.
tools.what_it_is: AI answer engine that searches the web and replies with cited answers, letting users choose among third-party frontier models. Surfaces: web, iOS/Android, desktop apps and the Chromium-based Comet browser with a built-in assistant.
key_capabilities: Pro Search multi-step answers with citations; Research mode for long reports
Model choice: GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Grok 4.7 and others; Max adds GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon, Claude Opus 5.5/Fable 5.1 and Model Council
Create files and apps: dashboards, spreadsheets, presentations
File uploads (PDF, CSV, audio, video, images); image and video generation
Perplexity Computer agent metered by credits; Comet browser automation
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Consumer Free/Pro/Max: 'AI Data Retention' is on by default, so queries train Perplexity models unless the user opts out, and opt-out covers only future data. Independent review: uploaded files kept about 30 days. No admin controls, SSO or retention policy on consumer plans. Company-level attestations on the trust centre: SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS SAQ A, FedRAMP 20x Low.
tools.licensing_pricing: Free $0; Pro US$20/month or $17/month annual; Max $200/month ($167 annual per independent trackers); Comet free; Sonar API billed separately from about $1 per million tokens. Not bundled with any suite. The vendor pricing page could not be opened, so prices come from two independent 2026 sources.
tools.integrations: Comet browser (Windows, macOS, mobile); file uploads; Sonar API. File connectors (Drive, SharePoint and others) are Enterprise-only.
tools.recent_developments: 2026: Comet on all platforms; Perplexity Computer with credit metering; Model Council and Brain memory for Max; model lineup refreshed to GPT-6, Gemini 4 and Claude 5.5-era models (Oct 2026). Litigation: the Dow Jones/New York Post copyright and trademark case closed fact discovery on 15 Oct 2026 and heads to a jury trial; Britannica/Merriam-Webster and Tribune suits are pending.
tools.best_fit_departments: 33 Market Research & CI (Core) is the natural home; 52 Research & Innovation and 02 Strategy benefit from cited technology and competitor scanning. 25 Procurement is a weak fit on consumer plans because RFP and supplier data would feed training by default; use Perplexity Enterprise instead.
tools.training_notes: Pro Search versus Research, evaluating sources, verifying quotes (publishers allege fabricated attributions), switching off AI Data Retention, never pasting confidential data, model selection and credit budgeting. Core 6 h; Advanced 12 h.
tools.caveats: Training on by default; active publisher lawsuits; citation-accuracy risk; credit system complexity and frequent plan changes; help-centre pages intermittently return errors; vendor list prices not confirmed on an official page during research.

tools.name: Perplexity Enterprise
tools.vendor: Perplexity AI, Inc. Tiers: Enterprise Pro and Enterprise Max, plus the Comet Enterprise browser and an Enterprise for Government offer. Brief's guess correct.
tools.what_it_is: Managed, organisation-wide Perplexity with an admin console, SSO, shared Projects and internal-knowledge search over connected files, delivered through the same web and mobile apps plus an MDM-deployable Comet Enterprise browser.
key_capabilities: All 11 models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 3.8/4, Claude Sonnet/Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Grok, Kimi, GLM, Nemotron); Model Council and Brain on Max
Internal knowledge via admin-governed File Connectors with user-level folder permissions
Shared Projects; Deep Research and Create files/apps at higher limits
Perplexity Computer credits: 500/month on Pro, 15,000 on Max
Comet Enterprise: silent MDM install, three agent-permission levels, telemetry and audit logs, opt-in CrowdStrike Falcon
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Enterprise Pro/Max: never used to train Perplexity models (contractual), with no-training/zero-retention agreements with third-party model providers reviewed annually; files deleted after 7 days by default; custom session retention and Enforce Incognito Mode (24-hour sessions); encryption at rest and in transit; SSO for all; SCIM, audit logs, Insights and retention settings require at least one Enterprise Max seat or 50 Pro seats. SOC 2 Type II; vendor claims HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS; trust centre adds ISO 27001:2022 and FedRAMP 20x Low. No data-residency option found.
tools.licensing_pricing: Enterprise Pro US$40/seat/month or $400/seat/year; Enterprise Max $325/seat/month or $3,250/seat/year; seats mixable; 25% discount for education, nonprofits and government; custom terms from 250 seats; no published minimum; card, invoice or bank transfer. Comet Enterprise included for Enterprise subscribers. Not bundled with a suite.
tools.integrations: Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint, Dropbox and Box connectors; SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM; MDM tools for Comet; CrowdStrike Falcon; Sonar API billed separately.
tools.recent_developments: 11 Mar 2026: CrowdStrike partnership for Comet Enterprise. 27 Aug 2026: Comet Enterprise GA with silent installer and agent permission tiers. Enterprise Max tier with Model Council, Brain and 15,000 monthly credits. Organisation file repository sunset 1 Oct 2026. Vendor claims 50,000+ organisations. Publisher litigation (Dow Jones) heading to trial.
tools.best_fit_departments: 33 Market Research & CI (Core), 02 Strategy and 52 Research all fit: cited external research combined with internal documents. None of the listed departments is a poor fit, but it is a research surface rather than a drafting or analytics suite, and SCIM/audit logs need a Max seat.
tools.training_notes: Everything in Perplexity plus connector scoping, Project sharing rules, retention and incognito settings, Comet agent permissions, credit management and citation verification. Core 6–8 h; Advanced 12–16 h; administrators add about 4 h.
tools.caveats: Governance features gated behind Max or 50 seats; no stated data residency; dependent on third-party model providers; Comet Enterprise is Windows/macOS only; help-centre pages intermittently error; publisher lawsuits; perplexity.ai pages were read via a reader proxy because direct fetches are blocked.
